thread:
Marta (partnerships): Quick sync: vendor roadmap + joint announce windows — need to align H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi timing with marketplace onramp + SI integrations. Can we confirm embargo windows and a fallback model list? Prefer an embargo-handshake by 04/18. @Raj @Kiara for capacity, @Ted for comms. Short answers pls. :eyes:

Raj (eng-runtime): Got it. For runtime we need kernel tags for H200 and MI300 by 04/12 to validate perf. Can you share target perf SLOs? Also any hard dates from vendors?

Marta (partnerships): Vendors provided tentative GA windows: H100: early May, H200: late May, MI300: mid-June, Gaudi: staggered June-July. Not final — need to lock by Wed. SLOs: p50 <= 120ms for short-gen, throughput tbd per SKU. I'll collect vendor notes.

Kiara (platform): Platform note: marketplace onboarding needs 2 weeks for image sigs + testing. If H200 is late May we should plan marketplace cutover 2nd week of June. Also need to bake fallback routing to `mi300-quant` and `gaudi-compat` for region mismatch.

Ted (sales): Comms: If we aim for a joint announce, vendors expect a 72-hour embargo window. Sales wants a preannounce internal deck by 04/20. I'll draft messaging but need confirmation on SW compatibility callouts.

Raj (eng-runtime): Quick checklist I can own: kernel tags, perf runbook, and fallback matrix. Need vendor firmware tags and example model <sequence lengths>. Can vendors share thermal/power limits? pinging announce-bot to add calendar block.

announce-bot: Added calendar: 'Vendor Roadmap Handshake' 2024-04-18 15:00 PT — invite sent to Marta, Raj, Kiara, Ted. :calendar:

Marta (partnerships): Thanks. Short action items: (1) Raj -> perf/kernels by 04/12 (2) Kiara -> marketplace staging requirements by 04/15 (3) Ted -> draft internal comms by 04/20 (4) Vendors -> final GA windows + firmware tags by 04/14. If any blockers call them out now.

Kiara (platform): One blocker: staging lab currently has limited B200 slots week of 04/15. Could we request 1 extra node from infra? @Raj can you escalate?

Raj (eng-runtime): Yep, I'll open infra ticket today with priority P2 and request temporary B200 slot. I'll post ticket id when created.

Ted (sales): Putting placeholder for embargo copy: 'Coordinated announce with partners — subject to vendor GA confirmation.' Will fill once vendor timelines firm.

Marta (partnerships): Perfect. If no objections I'll consolidate and send to vendors for handshake. :thumbsup:
